sourceAdaptations: Official picker.html full controls/layout/styles and inline handlers adapted to IIFE; original Poline engine unchanged, original webcomponent SVG generation and saturation-ring rotary math retained.
Google Fonts links removed, original Work Sans/Aboreto sans-serif fallback retained; no fonts/assets downloaded or encoded.
Original engine labels oklchCSS/lchCSS as approximate linear HSL rescaling; host adds explicit approximate headings instead of falsely claiming accurate color-space conversion.
Pointer capture added for all original drag paths; pointercancel/lostcapture/blur/hidden/disconnect clear pointer and rotary state. Existing original listeners removed on disconnect.
Zero bounds ignored in source pointer handlers/addPoint and host pointer position/selection handlers.

Official global keyboard handler now skips form/editable elements, key repeat, hidden state; prevents navigation only for handled keys. Host pointerdown selection listens in capture phase because original shadow handler stops propagation.
Hidden keeps original model/DOM and all control selections, only cancels pending drag. No RAF/timer loop exists; reduced preference has no continuous animation to stop.

Custom element constructor/connected initialization failures are caught and stored in initializationError; host explicitly checks after upgrade before continuing, startup try cleans and renders unavailable rather than relying on swallowed platform upgrade errors.
Adapter event ownership catches runtime SVG failures, removes root and listeners, reports unavailable; pagehide is terminal and old retained nodes cannot mutate model.

dedup.difference: Original multi-anchor connected palette interpolation, rotary per-anchor saturation, X/Y/Z interpolation functions and loop control; not same single-color/inertia interaction.
